{
  "gateway": "tiktok_native_action",
  "mode": "direct",
  "description": "Run a TikTok Business API action by name for deferred or advanced operations. Prefer named tools such as create campaign, fetch ad account, upload media, and get insights when they are available.",
  "inputSchema": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "action": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1,
        "description": "TikTok Business API action/tool name, LIST_ACTIONS, or DESCRIBE_ACTION. Use search=\"bc member\" or search=\"bc asset\" to discover Business Center access-management actions."
      },
      "target_action": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Action to inspect when action=DESCRIBE_ACTION."
      },
      "search": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "LIST_ACTIONS case-insensitive action, alias, category, endpoint, or documentation filter."
      },
      "category": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "LIST_ACTIONS category filter."
      },
      "read_only": {
        "type": "boolean",
        "description": "LIST_ACTIONS read/write filter."
      },
      "limit": {
        "type": "integer",
        "minimum": 1,
        "maximum": 500,
        "description": "LIST_ACTIONS page size; defaults to 50."
      },
      "offset": {
        "type": "integer",
        "minimum": 0,
        "description": "LIST_ACTIONS zero-based offset."
      },
      "connection_id": {
        "type": "string",
        "format": "uuid",
        "description": "Optional TikTok OAuth connection ID."
      },
      "advertiser_id": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "TikTok advertiser ID as a string."
      },
      "account_id": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Alias for advertiser_id."
      },
      "path_params": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": {},
        "description": "Templated path params."
      },
      "params": {
        "$ref": "#/properties/path_params",
        "description": "Native TikTok params."
      },
      "query": {
        "$ref": "#/properties/path_params",
        "description": "Explicit query params."
      },
      "payload": {
        "$ref": "#/properties/path_params",
        "description": "Native TikTok body exactly as documented."
      },
      "lead_region": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "eu",
          "us"
        ],
        "description": "Optional lead region header."
      },
      "aggregate_pages": {
        "type": "boolean",
        "default": false,
        "description": "Fetch additional list pages when true."
      },
      "max_pages": {
        "type": "integer",
        "minimum": 1,
        "maximum": 100,
        "default": 25,
        "description": "Page cap for aggregate_pages."
      },
      "confirmed": {
        "type": "boolean",
        "default": false,
        "description": "Required for destructive live calls."
      },
      "dry_run": {
        "type": "boolean",
        "default": true,
        "description": "Writes preview by default; read actions ignore it."
      },
      "skip_preflight": {
        "type": "boolean",
        "default": false,
        "description": "Bypass curated write preflight."
      },
      "override_preflight": {
        "type": "boolean",
        "default": false,
        "description": "Alias for skip_preflight."
      },
      "idempotency_key": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Idempotency key for writes."
      },
      "result_fields": {
        "type": "array",
        "items": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "description": "Project MCP result records to these fields."
      },
      "fields": {
        "type": "array",
        "items": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "description": "Alias for result_fields unless the action has a native fields parameter."
      },
      "max_items": {
        "type": "integer",
        "minimum": 1,
        "maximum": 10000,
        "description": "Cap returned arrays in the MCP result."
      },
      "compact": {
        "type": "boolean",
        "default": false,
        "description": "Remove null, empty string, and empty object values from the MCP result."
      }
    },
    "required": [
      "action"
    ],
    "additionalProperties": true,
    "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"
  },
